name: AgenticGraph Agent
description: Agent-readable discovery, published-document retrieval, and WebMCP-ready metadata surface for AgenticGraph.

supportedInterfaces.description: Primary machine interface for read-only discovery and source-file document access.
Published source-files index and storage-backed document read surface.

skills.name: Search AgenticGraph Source Files
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host needs to search published AgenticGraph Source Files and return stable document IDs for the `fetch` tool. Call this first for OpenAI Deep Research-style retrieval, Claude, Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, BytePlus ModelArk, and generic MCP clients.
examples: Search AgenticGraph Source Files for renderer architecture.

skills.name: Fetch AgenticGraph Source File
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host needs the complete published AgenticGraph Source File for an ID returned by `search`. Returns markdown as both `content` and `text` for OpenAI, Claude, Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, BytePlus ModelArk, and generic MCP clients.
examples: Fetch the AgenticGraph Source File id returned by search.

skills.name: List Source Files
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host needs the published AgenticGraph Source Files index as markdown.
examples: List the published AgenticGraph Source Files.

skills.name: Read Source File
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host knows a published AgenticGraph canonical path and needs that Editor Workspace markdown content. Defaults to the canonical docs workspace when workspaceId is omitted.
examples: Read the published source file for docs/getting-started.md.

skills.name: Read Shared Document
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host has a AgenticGraph share token or public AgenticGraph share/document URL and needs the published markdown content.
examples: Read the AgenticGraph shared document behind this share URL.

skills.name: Inspect Shared Document Structure
skills.description: Use this when an MCP host has a AgenticGraph share token or public AgenticGraph share/document URL and needs frontmatter/body structure without mutating the document.
examples: Inspect the structure of this AgenticGraph shared document.

skills.name: Inspect Agent Surface
skills.description: Use this when an MCP Apps-capable host or generic MCP client needs to inspect AgenticGraph agent-ready discovery, MCP Apps readiness, OpenAPI, and skill metadata.
examples: Show the AgenticGraph agent discovery metadata.
